profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Technical Lead at Clover, I focused on developing scalable backend systems and leading engineering efforts to build high-performance, reliable infrastructure. I worked on projects that improved merchant engagement, automation, and system efficiency, ensuring seamless integrations and uptime for thousands of users.

With a strong foundation in backend development, cloud infrastructure, and AI-driven automation, I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and optimizing system performance. I am passionate about designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions that drive business growth.

I thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful products. Always eager to learn new technologies and refine best practices, I am committed to building innovative and efficient systems.

As a Core Engineer at Ondot Systems, I have contributed to the maintenance and development of various functionalities for the fin-tech company's core product, which enables users to control their payment cards through mobile applications. I have built and implemented cloud native modular infrastructure, following the twelve-factor methodology and using tools such as Datadog, Amazon ECS, and Helm.

I graduated from the University of California, Davis, with a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, where I gained extensive experience in object-oriented analysis and design patterns, as well as hands-on experience with AngularJS and JavaScript. I am a creative, self-motivated, and diligent software engineer, with strong presentation and research skills, and a capacity to articulate in written expression. I am extremely interested and motivated to gain hands-on experience with new tech stacks and languages, and to work independently or in a team environment.
